definitionZh: :-moz-locale-dir(rtl) CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,如果用户界面被显示在右到左的位置,则它匹配一个元素. 这是由偏好intl.uidiction决定的。 locale(其中locale是当前locale)被设置为"rtl".
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-locale-dir(rtl) CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches an element if the user interface is being displayed right-to-left. This is determined by the preference intl.uidirection.locale (where locale is the current locale) being set to "rtl".
